title: Estimating the Evolution of Solution Norms in Vector Delay Nonlinear Systems: Stability and Boundedness
summary: Existing methods rarely capture the temporal evolution of solution norms in vector nonlinear DDEs with variable delays and coefficients, often leading to overly conservative boundedness and stability criteria. We develop a framework that constructs scalar counterparts of vector DDEs whose solutions upper-bound the evolution of the original solution norms when the corresponding history functions are matched.
